cand.title: ITB Americas 2027
cand.excerpt: High event credibility and geographic fit; current-edition accessibility is constrained by a confirmed non-hotel venue, so the opportunity is ranked for overflow/ancillary or future capture rather than assumed open inventory.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: María José Gómez, Hosted Buyer and Event Manager, is the strongest first contact for understanding hosted-buyer accommodation requirements and the selection route. Claudia Torres, Operations Manager, is relevant for accommodation/transport coordination and supplier-routing questions. Both are verified on the organizer team page; neither is proven to hold hotel signing authority. Vicente Salas Hesselbach, VP and Managing Director Americas, Messe Berlin, is a senior escalation and relationship-development contact.
findings.futureEdition: A 2027 edition in Guadalajara is announced and falls within the requested horizon. Date conflict: the organizer homepage FAQ states 9–11 November 2027; post-show reports dated 13 November 2026 state 16–18 November 2027 at Expo Guadalajara. The newer reporting suggests a schedule change, but no reconciled organizer confirmation was located. Keep verified date fields null pending written confirmation; do not confuse either activity range with article publication dates.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel profile: a 216-room full-service Expo-adjacent city hotel fits attendee, exhibitor, delegation and organizer accommodation more directly than a resort. The event is a three-day B2B exhibition with a parallel conference at Expo Guadalajara. Potential hotel uses are guestrooms, breakfast and small private meetings/receptions, not replacement of the exhibition venue. No room allocation, conversion rate, meeting requirement or forecast is published for Sheraton Guadalajara Expo.
findings.venueCommitments: Expo Guadalajara is the announced exhibition venue, including in the 2027 post-show announcement. This is a convention/exhibition center, not an incumbent hotel. Public announcement establishes venue selection, not access to a signed venue contract or hotel exclusivity.
findings.historicalRotation: The inaugural edition ran 10–12 November 2026 at Expo Guadalajara, Guadalajara, Jalisco, Mexico; it is already past as of 14 November 2026. No earlier ITB Americas editions or destination rotation are established. Jalisco tourism-authority reporting describes five consecutive Guadalajara editions, 2026–2030. This supports destination continuity, not an assumption that every future hotel contract is open or that dates beyond 2027 are fixed.
findings.accommodationSourcing: 2027 hotel sourcing status: UNKNOWN, not verified open or closed. Two distinct 2026 pathways are documented: organizer-listed special-rate hotels with direct property booking codes/links, and organizer-managed hosted-buyer accommodation. The 2026 buyer programme promises up to four nights, 9–13 November 2026, in one official four-star hotel near the venue, with venue shuttles. That hotel is not named in the reviewed buyer materials. These historical provisions do not establish 2027 terms, volumes, renewals, procurement timing, or available inventory.
findings.organizationStructure: Corporate trade-show organizer: Messe Berlin, with Messe Berlin Americas leadership and an ITB Americas operational team. This is not established as an association-owned congress. Expo Guadalajara is the venue; Jalisco tourism authorities are destination stakeholders. No separate PCO, hotel contracting agency, or DMC with demonstrated accommodation-contract authority was identified.
findings.competitiveLimitations: The historical organizer accommodation list includes The Westin Guadalajara, Hampton by Hilton Guadalajara Expo, Hotel Guadalajara Plaza Expo, City Express Plus by Marriott Guadalajara Expo, Fiesta Inn Guadalajara Expo and other properties. These are published 2026 rate/listing relationships, not proof of contracted or occupied blocks. The Westin is listed at 0.1 km from Expo, demonstrating a competing proximity proposition. The organizer also advertises more than 3,300 rooms within walking distance; that is surrounding supply, not event demand. No verified sellout, displaced demand, waitlist, overflow request or 2027 hotel exclusivity was found.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact María José Gómez and Claudia Torres first. Ask them to reconcile 9–11 versus 16–18 November 2027 and identify the person or intermediary responsible for hotel procurement. Request the 2027 hotel-selection timetable, incumbent hosted-buyer hotel and renewal/exclusivity position, preferred-hotel listing criteria, and any published room-night or peak-room brief. Then offer a tailored accommodation proposal and site visit for the supplied Expo-adjacent hotel; quote rates or reserve inventory only after dates, specifications and procurement accessibility are confirmed. Escalate strategic partnership discussions to Vicente Salas Hesselbach if appropriate.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: The latest held edition, 10–12 November 2026, has ended and is not a live sales opportunity. For the target 2027 edition, exhibition business is announced at Expo Guadalajara, while hotel-supplier accessibility remains unknown. A non-hotel venue does not by itself close accommodation procurement. No RFP, room block or open hotel tender is established.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: prioritize 2027 preferred-hotel inclusion, exhibitor/delegation stays and assessment of hosted-buyer supplier eligibility. Ancillary meetings or overflow are conditional sales hypotheses, not sourced demand. Announced annual recurrence and Guadalajara continuity support relationship development beyond 2027, but no later edition within the horizon has a verified date and no hotel rebid cycle is published.

Organizer team identities, public work emails and historical direct-booking accommodation list.
Historical hosted-buyer programme: one unnamed official four-star hotel, up to four nights, 9–13 November 2026.
Post-show report dated 13 November 2026: more than 4,000 attendees in 2026; return 16–18 November 2027 at Expo Guadalajara.
Government-attributed post-show reporting corroborates 16–18 November 2027, Expo Guadalajara and five Guadalajara editions through 2030.
Messe Berlin identifies itself as organizer and explicitly describes annual recurrence.
Five consecutive Jalisco editions through 2030 reported before the inaugural show.
Hotel fit and capture strategy are commercial inferences, not proof of open hotel procurement.

historicalEditions.attendancePublished: More than 4,000 professional attendees, reported after the event

suggestedOrsFollowUps: Obtain written date confirmation from the organizer before publishing calendar dates or requesting hotel inventory.
Ask the hosted-buyer and operations team for the accommodation decision-maker, incumbent arrangements and 2027 supplier-selection process.
Request an actual accommodation brief and evidence of any ancillary or overflow requirement before sizing demand or upgrading sales eligibility.

No published 2027 attendance forecast, room-night requirement, peak rooms, stay pattern or confirmed ancillary-meeting requirement was located.
